asi.corpus: 18 inputs x 8000 rounds, median of 3 Hermes runs

description: exp1: plain-decimal string fast path, BigNumber fallback for exponent/whitespace/radix inputs

asi.parity_quirk: -0.5@dec0 -> -0 (sign kept when nonzero truncates to zero); exact-zero parse drops sign

description: exp2: string-space exponent expansion (shift decimal point), covers 1e-18/2.5E2 forms without BigNumber

asi.exponent_bound: {1,3} digits, larger falls back to BigNumber (identical behavior)

description: exp3: manual char-code scanner replaces regex validation + replace() normalization (single pass, no regex in fast path)

asi.zero_rule: value zero iff all significand digits zero; sign kept only when nonzero truncated to zero

description: exp4: zero-allocation canonical fast return (return input string verbatim when already canonical)

asi.canonical_conditions: no sign char, no leading int zeros, no dangling dot, no trailing frac zeros, fracLen<=dp when truncating, dp<=MAX_FAST_DECIMALS
asi.bugs_found_in_first_attempt: +sign flag missing, dangling dot, dp>MAX_DP defer

description: exp5: native-regex canonical pre-check returns verbatim before manual scan

asi.insight: Hermes native regex test beats manual char scan for canonical inputs; non-canonical pay regex+scan (small regression on those, large win overall)

description: exp6: index-based assembly for plain path, one-expression fast exits for common exponent shapes, shared finishNormalize tail

asi.exp4_note: in-scan canonical return removed (superseded by exp5 regex pre-check); unused hasSign/hasDot dropped

description: exp7: typeof+comparison truncation guard (NaN-safe) replaces Number.isFinite builtin calls in hot paths

asi.infinity_case: +Infinity decimals now defers to BigNumber via MAX check (identical result, slower - acceptable ultra-rare path)

asi.purpose: establish repeated-measurement noise for >=2x-noise keep threshold
establish repeated-measurement noise for >=2x-noise keep threshold

description: exp12: RANGE-config guard for fast path (closure-scoped bound snapshot, sampled refresh every 64 calls + on every fallback, magnitude gates via digit-count bound) — REQUIRED: pre-guard fast path fails new nondefault-RANGE parity suite (verified). Explored object-property (96), closure (95), sentinel-encoded counter (97) variants; all within load-noise. Metric regressed vs 89 best but 89 was invalid under completed parity suite (config blocks prove wrong output under RANGE=5).

asi.hypothesis: fast path must gate against BigNumber global RANGE config or return wrong values under nondefault config
asi.finding: pre-guard code fails CONFIG_PARITY (returns fast-path result where reference returns 0 under RANGE=5); guard cost ~5-7ms under load, unmeasurable across variants due to load-avg-26 noise
asi.next: verify scaling sweep flat, then stop micro-tuning (noise floor exceeded)
